preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(k) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{x1} {y1} {x2} {y2}' for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations)
postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of operations k followed by the operations themselves.
The number of operations k must match the number of operations listed.

postconditions.expression: all(any((x1, y1) in edges and (x2, y2) not in edges for x1, y1, x2, y2 in operations))
postconditions.description: Each operation must remove an existing edge and add a new edge not already present.
